import MeasureTheory.Measure
import ProbabilityTheory.Law
import ProbabilityTheory.Gaussian

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {X : Ω → E} [NormedSpace ℝ E] (hX : ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw X P) : ProbabilityTheory.HasGaussianLaw (-X) P := by
  have h_char_conj : ∀ t : E*, charFunction (-X) P t = conj (charFunction X P t) := by
    intro t
    rw [charFunction_def, integral_neg]
    congr'
    ext f
    rw [integral_conj]
    congr'
  let ϕ_X := charFunction X P
  let ϕ_negX := charFunction (-X) P
  have h_char_eq : ∀ t : E*, ϕ_negX t = conj (ϕ_X t) := h_char_conj
  have h_gauss_negX : HasGaussianLaw (-X) P := by
    apply HasGaussianLaw.congr
    erw h_char_eq
    exact hX
  exact h_gauss_negX
